draft.briefing: Hey, you're at Tambdi Surla! The Mahadev Temple here is a 13th century Shiva temple built in the Kadamba style, and people still come to worship in it today.
draft.hungryLine: There's no food scene out here, so bring snacks and water with you.

moodReplies.show-me-around: The Mahadev Temple is about a 15 min walk from here.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Find a quiet spot near the old Mahadev Temple and take in the stonework.
moodReplies.surprise-me: The temple reminds many people of the temples at Aihole in neighbouring Karnataka.

spots.name: Mahadev Temple
spots.detail: 15 min walk · A 13th century Kadamba style Shiva temple, still in worship

tips.title: Dress modestly.
tips.body: The Mahadev Temple is an active place of Hindu worship, so cover up and be respectful.

tips.title: Treat it gently.
tips.body: It's an ASI protected Monument of National Importance, so treat the old stones with care.

story.title: Built for Shiva
story.body: The Mahadev Temple at Tambdi Surla was built in the 13th century and dedicated to Lord Shiva.

story.title: A Kadamba design
story.body: It was built in the Kadamba style and is reminiscent of the temples at Aihole in Karnataka.

story.title: Protected and alive
story.body: The Archaeological Survey of India protects it as a Monument of National Importance in Goa, and it is still an active place of worship.
